title: An addressed /automation/:ns/:name/(runs|trigger) under an unserved verb answers the transport's 405 (Allow: GET, HEAD, details envelope), not the automation domain's 405 the bare path gives
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw6yXcLi9aRRBpPT4W

## Reproduction (stock showcase at ee9ad834, admin session; reproduced twice)

1. `DELETE /api/v1/automation/showcase_batch_reminders/runs` (bare) → 405, `Allow: GET`, dispatcher envelope `{…, "httpStatus": 405}`.
2. `DELETE /api/v1/automation/showcase/showcase_batch_reminders/runs` (addressed, ADR-0150) → 405, `Allow: GET, HEAD`, transport envelope `{"error":{"code":"METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED","message":"DELETE is not supported for … Allowed: GET, HEAD.","details":{"method":…,"path":…,"allowed":…}}}`.
3. Same split for POST/PUT on the addressed `/runs`, for GET on `/automation/showcase/FLOW/trigger`, and for GET on `/automation/trigger/showcase/FLOW`; each bare counterpart answers the domain's 405.

Expected: ADR-0150 D5, an address is served exactly as the bare path, so the addressed shapes answer the automation domain's 405 (`automationRouteAllow`, `Allow: GET`, dispatcher envelope).

## Mechanism

The dispatcher declares only the two-segment `/automation` patterns as domain-decides-every-verb (#24228, pinned by `packages/runtime/src/automation-every-verb.hono.integration.test.ts`). The addressed three-segment mounts (`/automation/:ns/:name/runs`, `/automation/:ns/:name/trigger`, `/automation/trigger/:ns/:name`) are not declared, so they fall through to Hono's method-not-allowed and `automationRouteAllow` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-address.ts`) never answers. `automation-addressed-route.test.ts` drives the addressed rows on the bare dispatcher only, so no pin reaches this. This is the checklist item's own `dispatcher-vs-hono-route` trap.

Impact: low. The transport's Allow is not false, because HEAD is served, but a client sees two envelopes and two Allow headers for one route depending on the address.

Fix direction: extend the every-verb declaration to the addressed shapes, and add a three-segment row to `automation-every-verb.hono.integration.test.ts`.
